verdict.rationale: Firebase is a backend platform with managed databases, so automated backups and point-in-time recovery are a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never documents scheduled backups, restore, or point-in-time recovery. Multi-region replication is a different, adjacent capability, and a user exporting data to switch providers is a user-side workaround; neither counts here.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on automated backups and point-in-time recovery for my data
